assertions.title: Launch and cancel runs

steps.action: Preflight GET /api/admin/monitor/runs with bearer token before UI interaction
steps.observed: HTTP 200 with monitor payload returned; endpoint healthy

steps.action: From Agent Monitor, launch run with thinking mode 'always' and click Stop Active while run is running
steps.expected: Run launches, thinking mode persists as 'always', terminal status becomes canceled
steps.observed: Run run_1773491702174684706 launched and was observed running; /v1/runs/{id} recorded thinking_mode='always'; Stop Active POST returned 200 but terminal status became completed (not canceled)

steps.action: From Agent Monitor, launch run with thinking mode 'on_error' and click per-row Stop while run is running
steps.expected: Run launches, thinking mode persists as 'on_error', terminal status becomes canceled
steps.observed: Run run_1773491770215811582 launched and was observed running; /v1/runs/{id} recorded thinking_mode='on_error'; per-row Stop POST returned 200 but terminal status became completed (not canceled)

evidence.network: Preflight GET /api/admin/monitor/runs -> 200; POST /v1/runs -> 202 for both launches with thinking_mode payloads; POST /api/admin/monitor/runs/control -> 200 for both cancels; captured in react-migration/monitor-rerun5/VAL-MIG-MON-002-network-events.json

assertions.issues: Both cancellation paths were invoked while runs were actively running, but neither targeted run transitioned to canceled terminal status; both ended completed.

frictions.description: agent-browser CLI session could not launch due missing libnspr4 linkage in daemon-spawned browser process.
frictions.resolution: Used Playwright Chromium automation with LD_LIBRARY_PATH pointing to /home/mojo/.cache/playwright-libs/root/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu to complete the same dashboard UI flow and capture screenshots/network evidence.

summary: Validated VAL-MIG-MON-002 on rerun5: preflight endpoint healthy (200), both launch attempts applied selected thinking mode (always/on_error), but Stop Active and per-row Stop did not produce canceled terminal state. Observed run_1773491702174684706=completed and run_1773491770215811582=completed.
